summary: changed_region() unions every footprint model (for rule in (False, True)) instead of hard-coding the narrow perpendicular one, so the judged command this file's own docstring mandates no longer reports a violated must-be-zero. Verified by running the command verbatim on the arm's two result directories under BOTH rules: outside = 0 on all 28 captures under --extent-rule and 0 on all 28 under the default. The eleven-class table under --extent-rule is identical to pass 1b's and to the one NOTES.md now carries (ALL 225570, 96.05% -> 100.00%, moved 8920).
scenario: Pass 1b's scenario -- the next person judging an arm the way line_priority_arms.py instructs (--extent-rule) meets a non-zero 'outside' against a footnote calling it a must-be-zero, and either spends a remediation cycle hunting a scoping escape that does not exist or learns the column is noisy and stops reading it -- can no longer occur on this arm under either rule.
evidence: Re-measured, not accepted. (1) Both runs of `line_priority_arms.py --a .../1789968297-arms-primpv13-base-2094212 --b .../1789968297-arms-primpv13-fix-2094234 [--extent-rule] --min-width 8 --max-width 63.875` give outside = 0 on every one of 28 captures. (2) 'No other column moves' is structural, not lucky: changed_region() is called once, at :280, its result feeds only scope[test] = (diff.sum(), (diff & ~reg).sum()), and scope is read only to print 'outside'; A!=B px is diff.sum() and never sees the region. (3) The cost of the widening, measured at every width against the real capture pair: the region grew 2.9-4.1% of its own area (at w=63.875, 74,198 -> 76,383 px of a 307,200-px frame, i.e. 2,185 px, 0.7% of the frame's exclusion given up), and 17 of 28 captures read non-zero under the perpendicular region against 0 of 28 under the union. Those 17 values -- 1,2,5,6,6,7,7,8,8,9,8,8,8,8,8,9,9 from w=40 to w=63.875 -- reproduce pass 1b's table to the digit, and they are ALSO what the threaded-rule fix pass 1b asked for would give in default mode, since threading extent_rule=False reproduces the perpendicular region exactly. (4) Positive control run rather than believed: at w=63.875 the region is 76,383 px of 307,200 (24.86%, 230,817 excluded, both figures as documented); a single differing pixel planted at each of three excluded coordinates (0,0), (245,29), (479,639) gives outside = 1, and one planted at included (236,232) gives outside = 0. (5) The soundness argument holds: (max + min/2)/L as a function of edge angle is cos t + sin t / 2 on [0,45] -- 1.0 axis-aligned, 1.118 maximum at 26.57 degrees, 1.0607 at 45, never below 1 -- so the derived extent contains the perpendicular footprint at every angle and the union IS the extent footprint today.

summary: The changed_region() docstring understates the alternative it rejects by a factor of eight, and contradicts itself four sentences apart. It says threading the rule through 'leaves the DEFAULT reading 1 and 2 px outside at w = 40 and 48'; threading extent_rule=False gives exactly the perpendicular region, which the same docstring says made 17 of the window's 28 captures non-zero. The residual is 1,2,5,6,6,7,7,8,8,9,8,8,8,8,8,9,9 px on seventeen captures from w = 40 upward.
scenario: Someone simplifying changed_region() -- reasonable, since the union costs a doubled inner loop -- reads '1 and 2 px at w = 40 and 48', judges the union over-engineering for a two-pixel residual, reverts to the threaded form, and seventeen captures go non-zero again on the default rule. That is the exact cycle pass 1b already spent.
evidence: Measured at every width in the window against the real capture pair, with both regions computed side by side: perpendicular vs union region size and outside count per capture (see the MEDIUM-1 table in the .md record). 17 of 28 non-zero under perpendicular, 0 of 28 under the union. LOW and not MEDIUM because it is a statement about a REJECTED alternative in a comment -- no shipped behaviour, no scored number and no leg's verdict depends on it -- and the error runs against its own argument, making the union look less necessary than it is, so it cannot mislead anyone into shipping the weaker region.
remediation: One sentence: replace the clause with 'leaves the DEFAULT reading 1-9 px outside on 17 of the window's 28 captures, w = 40 upward'. Not sent back for a cycle: an auditor may not edit a lane file, and the correction is on the record here, beside the file, in the same fold.
